newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU condemns shootings on Israel-Jordan border.
newsitem.headline: EU condemns shootings on Israel-Jordan border.

text.p: The European Union condemned Thursday's killing of seven Israeli schoolgirls on the Israeli-Jordanian border and expressed its sympathy for the people and government of Israel.
"We strongly condemn this despicable act, which claimed the lives of Israeli schoolgirls and seriously wounded others," the Dutch presidency of the European Union said in a statement.

"The European Union shares the feeling of sorrow and grief of the people and government of Israel. We wish to express our condolences to the families of the victims for the loss of their loved ones," the statement said.
A lone Jordanian soldier shot dead seven Israeli schoolgirls and wounded six while the children were on a field trip to the border between Israel and Jordan on Thursday.
